definitions.explanation: Expressing that something is disappointing, unsatisfactory, or falls short of expectations. Commonly used in formal statements and official apologies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誠|まこと}に→誠に：28350_makotoni⟧{遺憾|いかん}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
{遺憾|いかん}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{添|そ}えませんでした→添える：13315_soeru⟧。
examples.english: Regrettably, we were unable to meet your expectations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遺憾|いかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意|い}→意：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表明|ひょうめい}した→表明：14052_hyoumei⟧。
{遺憾|いかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。

notes:
REGISTER: Highly formal. Used in official statements, diplomatic language, and formal apologies. Rarely used in everyday conversation.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {遺憾|いかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (find regrettable)
- {遺憾|いかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意|い}→意：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{表明|ひょうめい}する→表明：14052_hyoumei⟧ (express regret)
- {遺憾|いかん}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧ (regrettably)
- ⟦{誠|まこと}に→誠に：28350_makotoni⟧{遺憾|いかん} (truly regrettable)
- {遺憾|いかん}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧ (demonstrate fully, without reservation)

NOTE ON {遺憾|いかん}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: This phrase means 'fully, completely' and comes from '(regret) nothing is left out.' ⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{遺憾|いかん}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{発揮|はっき}する→発揮する：17267_hakkisuru⟧ (fully demonstrate one's ability).

DIPLOMATIC USE: In Japanese diplomatic and political language, {遺憾|いかん} is often used as a measured response that expresses dissatisfaction without being as strong as an outright condemnation.
